email_body:
Dear Head of Communications, Marketing and Policy,

I am writing to apply for the Communications Consultant role supporting the Entrepreneurship Education campaign and GEN-E 2027. Your focus on turning storytelling into coordinated, data-informed campaigns resonates with how I work: I build and optimise websites, write content that ranks, and use analytics to guide decisions.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing roles, I manage CMS content, run SEO and social media integration, and track performance with Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. I have co-created content with clients and teams across countries, and I am comfortable working remotely with international stakeholders. I also bring technical skills in WordPress, Canva and AI tools that help streamline content production and reporting.

I would welcome the chance to contribute to Europe's largest youth entrepreneurship festival and to help amplify the stories of young entrepreneurs. Thank you for considering my application.

Warm regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Head of Communications, Marketing and Policy,

I am excited to apply for the Communications Consultant position at JA Europe, supporting the Entrepreneurship Education campaign and GEN-E 2027. The opportunity to shape communications for Europe's largest youth entrepreneurship festival, and to work with a network that inspires young people, aligns closely with my professional interests and skills.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I plan and execute content strategies, manage CMS platforms, and use analytics to refine campaigns. I have developed monthly content calendars, co-created material with clients and team members across different countries, and tracked performance using Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs. For example, I built and optimised a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion, implementing structured data and running iterative SEO audits that measurably improved search health. This experience has taught me how to turn data into actionable recommendations and to coordinate multiple deliverables under deadlines.

I am comfortable working remotely with international teams and have a strong interest in youth entrepreneurship and education. My technical background in WordPress, Canva and AI tools enables me to produce content efficiently and to adapt to new platforms quickly. I am eager to bring my organisational skills, analytical mindset and collaborative approach to JA Europe's communications team.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to the success of GEN-E 2027 and the Entrepreneurship Education campaign.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok
